notes: LearningHub download endpoint required payment; hidden document paths were not followed.
Senkolink source returned HTTP 403; not bypassed.
A PDF is not called a completed structured examination merely because it was downloaded.
All acquired files preserve the complete original PDF bytes and page count; no questions were summarised or truncated.
Mkalama records retain exact source subject labels. Ordinary History, religious subjects and Sport Studies were not mapped into the compulsory subject list.
Three generic opening/test documents have no year visible in extracted header text; 2025 is an explicit archive-page attribution recorded in yearBasis, not a PDF-date inspection claim.
